items.example: We're having a great time in Greece.
What are you thinking about? — About my holiday.
What is he doing? — He's packing the bags.
We're waiting for the museum to open.
We're standing in the sun and we're getting very bored.
We are looking at photos of the buildings.
Everyone is sitting for a photo by the pool.
They're in the sun, Brazil won the match — life is perfect.
Thinking about you all in the office! See you next week.
He brought me breakfast in bed.
Men talk about sport, computers and videos.

items.phrase: look at your messages on a large screen

items.example: We read our messages on a large screen in the kitchen.
